// The Go twin of main.xo: proto.Unmarshal and proto.Marshal of
// descriptorpb.FileDescriptorProto (google.golang.org/protobuf).
package main

import (
	"encoding/hex"
	"fmt"
	"os"

	"google.golang.org/protobuf/proto"
	"google.golang.org/protobuf/types/descriptorpb"
)

const descHex = ""

func main() {
	w := "decode"
	if len(os.Args) > 1 {
		w = os.Args[1]
	}
	data, _ := hex.DecodeString(descHex)
	sum := len(data)
	switch w {
	case "decode":
		for i := 0; i < 2000; i++ {
			var f descriptorpb.FileDescriptorProto
			if err := proto.Unmarshal(data, &f); err == nil {
				sum += len(f.MessageType) + len(f.GetName())
				for _, m := range f.MessageType {
					sum += len(m.Field)
				}
			}
		}
	case "encode":
		var f descriptorpb.FileDescriptorProto
		if err := proto.Unmarshal(data, &f); err != nil {
			panic(err)
		}
		for i := 0; i < 2000; i++ {
			if b, err := proto.Marshal(&f); err == nil {
				sum += len(b)
			}
		}
	}
	fmt.Println(w, sum)
}
